description: This file defines classes and functions for handling Unix domain socket messages, including control messages, file descriptors, and credentials, within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It provides interfaces for sending and receiving messages over Unix sockets with support for Linux-specific features.
external_methods: Result (methods like FromFileDescriptors, AsSharedFDs, WriteMessage, ReadMessage, EnableCredentials)

classes.name: ControlMessage
classes.description: Represents a control message for Unix socket communication, capable of handling file descriptors and credentials, with static methods for creation from raw data or file descriptors.

classes.name: UnixSocketMessage
classes.description: Encapsulates a message with data and control messages, providing methods to check for file descriptors and credentials, and retrieve them.

classes.name: UnixMessageSocket
classes.description: Provides an interface for socket communication, allowing writing and reading messages, with optional support for credentials on Linux.

methods.name: FromRaw
methods.description: Creates a ControlMessage from a raw cmsghdr pointer.

methods.name: FromFileDescriptors
methods.description: Creates a ControlMessage from a vector of SharedFD objects.

methods.name: Raw
methods.description: Returns the raw cmsghdr pointer associated with the ControlMessage.

methods.name: IsCredentials
methods.description: Checks if the ControlMessage contains credentials (Linux-specific).

methods.name: IsFileDescriptors
methods.description: Checks if the ControlMessage contains file descriptors.

methods.name: AsSharedFDs
methods.description: Retrieves the file descriptors from the ControlMessage.

methods.name: HasFileDescriptors
methods.description: Checks if the UnixSocketMessage contains file descriptors.

methods.name: FileDescriptors
methods.description: Retrieves file descriptors from the UnixSocketMessage.

methods.name: HasCredentials
methods.description: Checks if the UnixSocketMessage contains credentials (Linux-specific).

methods.name: UnixMessageSocket
methods.description: Class for managing Unix socket communication, including writing and reading messages, with optional credentials support.
